title: Karbala Hai Meray Sir Da Kaaba
body:
Makkay Chay Aab-e-Zam Zam Pay Peenday (x2) Taraeh Deen Da Payaasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahdan Medina Hai Jaa Aman Di
Kyun Zakhmi Thee Gayi Mayyat Hassan Di (x2)
Mola Hassan Day Waris Puttar Da (x2) Haye Lutiya Sehra.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haji Dasaidan Baqiya Udaas Ay
Lokan Toun Puchiya Milya Jawab Ay (x2)
Haar Roaz Apnay Bachray Koon Rowan (x2) Waindi Ay Zahra.
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas Ghazi Day Bazoo Katay Hin
Dariya Kinaray Pyaasay Kussay Hin (x2)
Zawwar Saaray Ro Ro Dasaydin (x2) Oh Wagda Dariya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mukarram Tay Koyi Munawwar Shehar Hin
Nabiyan Tay Waliyan Day Jithay Honday Ghaar Hin (x2)
Makkah, Medina, Bait Ul Muqaddas (x2) Laykin Muhalla.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Kiya Dasaoon Eh Gal Rovaya
Sarwar Nay Jehkoon Mohndiyaan Tay Chaya (x2)
Ummat Nay Ohdaa Bay Jurm Kita (x2) Pamaal Laasha.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maikoon Loak Aakhan, Daidan Salah Aain
Makkay Koon Jawain, Haji Sadawain (x2)
Hai Gal Barhaq, Paar Dil Paya Aakhay (x2) Akbar Da Baba.
